prompt_en: Create a cinematic horizontal 16:9 war photograph of an unmistakably adult Korean woman matching the supplied portrait. Her intact adult facial geometry and long dark waves remain the frame's human center. She wears black cat ears and a black-and-white combat-ready maid dress. In a shattered modern city street, as collapsing masonry erupts behind her, she braces a recognizable K2 rifle. The same camera-viewer is her clear relationship target. Brows knitted and lips pressed into an irritated pout, she scolds the same camera-viewer to stay behind cover while keeping the K2 rifle aimed directly through the lens. A blush across her cheeks and a brief softness in her eyes betray protective affection. Her shoulders tense as she shields the viewer, and the camera-viewpoint is now low and safely tucked behind a concrete barrier. Every gaze, warning, and protective movement addresses that same camera-viewer. Frame her from the knees up, face unobstructed, rifle foreshortened toward the lens. Broken facades and lane markings converge toward her face and the K2 sight line. Firelight from behind rims the cat ears and flying hair while smoky daylight keeps her eyes readable. Drifting dust, realistic skin, fabric, and documentary depth.
negative_en: low resolution, illustration look, cartoon style, fake-looking background, excessive HDR, over-processed retouching, overly smooth fur, awkward animal anatomy, 3D render look
